policy: Primary papers, official project pages, and official documentation only. External results are design evidence and are never reported as Parcel measurements.

sources.title: A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems
sources.used_for: Constant-velocity state estimation baseline
sources.limits: A linear Gaussian tracker does not capture multimodal pedestrian intent.

sources.title: Negative Information for Occlusion Reasoning in Dynamic Extended Multiobject Tracking
sources.used_for: Visibility-aware use of missed detections and occlusion in track-existence reasoning
sources.limits: Its sensor/platform results do not calibrate Parcel's Mid-series LiDAR and camera.

sources.title: Bayesian Occupancy Filter for Dynamic Environments
sources.used_for: Probabilistic dynamic occupancy and free-space updates
sources.limits: Grid-filter assumptions and costs require device-specific evaluation.

sources.title: Nav2 Obstacle Layer documentation
sources.used_for: Marking, clearing, raytrace range, persistence, and expected-update semantics
sources.limits: Configuration features do not by themselves distinguish occlusion from explicit free space.

sources.title: Nav2 Collision Monitor configuration
sources.used_for: Independent downstream stop/slow/approach safety shield
sources.limits: The monitor is a last-line collision-avoidance component, not a social predictor or safety certification.

sources.title: Trajectron++: Dynamically-Feasible Trajectory Forecasting With Heterogeneous Data
sources.used_for: Multimodal, interaction-aware trajectory-distribution challenger
sources.limits: Best-of-sample displacement error is insufficient for closed-loop safety or calibration.

sources.title: AgentFormer: Agent-Aware Transformers for Socio-Temporal Multi-Agent Forecasting
sources.used_for: Interaction-aware multimodal forecasting challenger
sources.limits: Offline trajectory metrics do not establish Go2 closed-loop performance or deadline compliance.

sources.title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Motion Planning among Dynamic Agents
sources.used_for: Calibrated multi-step prediction sets coupled to model-predictive control
sources.limits: Coverage guarantees depend on assumptions and calibration data; they do not replace the reactive safety shell.

sources.title: Optimal Reciprocal Collision Avoidance
sources.used_for: Fast reciprocal velocity-selection baseline
sources.limits: Core guarantees assume reciprocal agents and idealized state/geometry; ordinary pedestrians need not cooperate.

sources.title: Proactive Opinion-Driven Robot Navigation Around Human Movers
sources.used_for: Commitment-based resolution of reciprocal yielding and deadlock
sources.limits: Reported experiments do not validate Parcel's sensors, gait, or crowded-sidewalk ODD.

sources.title: Unfreezing the Robot: Navigation in Dense, Interacting Crowds
sources.used_for: Joint interaction prediction as a response to the freezing-robot problem
sources.limits: The model and platform differ from a quadruped companion and do not provide a hard safety boundary.

sources.title: Group Surfing: A Pedestrian-Based Approach to Sidewalk Robot Navigation
sources.used_for: Sidewalk flow/group hypotheses and documented outdoor failure modes
sources.limits: Pedestrian flow is a soft navigation cue and never road-crossing authority.

sources.title: Adaptive Side-by-Side Social Robot Navigation to Approach and Interact with People
sources.used_for: Adaptive companion-formation regions rather than a single point goal
sources.limits: Human comfort findings and robot geometry do not define Parcel's physical clearance.

sources.title: Principles and Guidelines for Evaluating Social Robot Navigation Algorithms
sources.used_for: Multi-metric, scenario-diverse, human-centered evaluation design
sources.limits: Guidelines structure evaluation but do not set a universal safe distance.

sources.title: SocNavBench: A Grounded Simulation Testing Framework for Evaluating Social Navigation
sources.used_for: Held-out replay against real pedestrian trajectories and interpretable social metrics
sources.limits: Benchmark geometry and embodiment need adaptation to Go2 footprint and companion formations.

sources.title: HuNavSim: A ROS 2 Human Navigation Simulator for Benchmarking Human-Aware Robot Navigation
sources.used_for: Reactive human and group scenarios across simulator backends
sources.limits: Synthetic social agents can encode their own behavior assumptions and must not be the only test domain.

sources.title: SocialGym 2.0
sources.used_for: Fast repeatable social-navigation policy sweeps and curricula
sources.limits: Planar simulation cannot validate legged stopping, gait sweep, curbs, or door thresholds.

sources.title: A Procedure for Taking a Remotely Controlled Elevator with an Autonomous Mobile Robot Based on 2D LIDAR
sources.used_for: Door-region sensing and explicit elevator boarding/alighting phases
sources.limits: A wheeled platform and authored elevator setup do not validate Go2 threshold locomotion or reflective-sensor behavior.

sources.title: PIE: A Large-Scale Dataset and Models for Pedestrian Intention Estimation and Trajectory Prediction
sources.used_for: Roadside pedestrian-intent features and evaluation data
sources.limits: Driver-view crossing intention is not sufficient evidence for a dog robot to enter a road.

sources.title: PIDNet: A Real-Time Semantic Segmentation Network Inspired by PID Controllers
sources.used_for: On-device semantic segmentation candidate for sidewalks, curbs, crosswalks, doors, and floor
sources.limits: Paper timing and accuracy must be reprofiled on the intended AGX Orin camera pipeline.

sources.title: Unitree RL Lab
sources.used_for: Vendor Go2 Isaac simulation, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real locomotion path
sources.limits: Vendor simulator support does not qualify Parcel's payload, navigation, perception, or safety.

sources.title: Isaac Sim Domain Randomization documentation
sources.used_for: Sensor, latency, appearance, and environment randomization design
sources.limits: Randomization needs measured real distributions; arbitrary variation is not sim-to-real validation.

sources.title: ISO 13482:2014 Robots and robotic devices — Safety requirements for personal care robots
sources.used_for: Hazard-analysis design input for a personal-care-like mobile robot
sources.limits: This project has not performed a conformity assessment and makes no compliance claim.
